rubrics.justification: It correctly states that no image was provided and avoids fabricating embryo morphology, but therefore offers no actual morphological assessment.
It integrates most relevant factors well, including age, PCOS, ovarian reserve, BMI, sperm quality, endometrium, prior IVF failure, and transfer day, with generally appropriate links to prognosis.

The reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with probability ranges tied to embryo quality and patient factors; minor overinterpretation exists around prior failure and some speculative causes.

Most recommendations are broadly evidence-based (single embryo transfer, luteal support, uterine cavity review), but ERA/EMMA/ALICE, immunologic workup, and strong endorsement of PGT-A in a young patient after one failed cycle are not strongly guideline-supported.
Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, though some suggested add-on tests are more speculative than standard.
